text:
```yaml
name: Autofix

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js 24
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '24'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run all

    - name: Commit changes using autofix-ci
      uses: autofix-ci/action@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

yaml:
name: Autofix

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-autofix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js 24
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '24'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run all

    - name: Commit changes using autofix-ci
      uses: autofix-ci/action@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
